name: [NWI] One-off Load: BC Customers + Contacts -> HubSpot

parameters.content:
## NWI - One-off load: BC customers + contacts -> HubSpot companies + contacts
**Run this once, by hand (Execute workflow). Test first:** set `maxCustomers` in *Workflow Config* to 50, run, check the records in HubSpot, then set it to 0 (= all) and run again. Re-runs are safe: anything already in HubSpot (matched on the BC number) is skipped.
1. Credentials: **HubSpot Service Key account** (companies + contacts read/write) and **Business Central – NWI Group (client credentials)**. Confirm no "not connected" warning on any node.
2. BC web service **Customer_Card** (page 21) must be published. Also publish the BC contact card page (5050) as a web service named `Contact_Card` (or change bcContactPage in Workflow Config): contact Segment and Sub_Segment are read from it. Confirm the BC field `Sub_Segment` exists on Customer_Card and Contact_Card (the first test run fails with a clear error if the name differs).
3. HubSpot company properties needed: `business_central_id`, `segment`, `sub_segement` (as spelled in HubSpot), `abn`, `invoice_email`, `responsibility_center`, `location_code`. Contact: `business_central_record_id`. Dropdown values (segment, sub segment, responsibility center, location code) must include every BC value or that batch of 100 fails.
4. BC reads are paged. In each *Read BC ...* node, Options -> Pagination should show "Response Contains Next URL".
5. Blocked customers are skipped. Only Person contacts linked to an in-scope customer are loaded. No owner is set.
6. Contacts are associated to their company (company becomes the contact's primary company).
7. After the load, delete or leave this workflow inactive. Daily syncs keep BC and HubSpot aligned afterwards.

## 1. Read from Business Central
All customers, their company contacts, all Person contacts and contact segments (paged, a few big calls).

## 2. Companies
Find existing (by business_central_id), create the missing ones in batches of 100.

## 3. Contacts + associations
Find existing (by business_central_record_id), create the missing ones, then associate every contact to its company.

nodes.name: Workflow Config
nodes.notes: maxCustomers: 0 = all customers; set a number (e.g. 50) to test. companyFieldMap / contactFieldMap: BC field -> HubSpot property.

nodes.name: Read BC Customers
nodes.notes: Every customer with all the fields we load. Blocked ones are dropped in the next step.

nodes.name: Read BC Company Contacts
nodes.notes: Each customer's BC company contact number: the link between a customer and its Person contacts. Runs once.

nodes.name: Read BC Person Contacts
nodes.notes: Every Person contact with the fields we load. Runs once.

nodes.name: Read BC Contact Segments
nodes.notes: Segment and Sub Segment for every contact, from the BC contact card web service (name set in Workflow Config: bcContactPage). Runs once.

nodes.name: Prepare Customer Batches
nodes.notes: Skips blocked / nameless customers, applies maxCustomers, builds the company properties and batches of 100.

nodes.name: Find Existing Companies
nodes.notes: Read-only search (POST is only the HubSpot search convention): one call per batch of 100 customers.

nodes.name: Build Company Creates
nodes.notes: Companies already in HubSpot are left alone; the rest go into the create payload.

nodes.name: Has New Companies
nodes.notes: true = some companies need creating in this batch.

nodes.name: Create Companies
nodes.notes: Batch create, up to 100 companies per call. Create call: no retry, by design.

nodes.name: Wait For Company Step
nodes.notes: Both paths (created / nothing to create) meet here so the contact step starts once, after every company exists.

nodes.name: Build Company Map And Contact Batches
nodes.notes: Customer number -> HubSpot company id (existing + created), then every Person contact joined to its customer. Batches of 100.

nodes.name: Find Existing Contacts
nodes.notes: Read-only search: one call per batch of 100 contacts.

nodes.name: Build Contact Creates
nodes.notes: Contacts already in HubSpot are left alone; the rest go into the create payload.

nodes.name: Has New Contacts
nodes.notes: true = some contacts need creating in this batch.

nodes.name: Create Contacts
nodes.notes: Batch create, up to 100 contacts per call. Create call: no retry, by design. A contact whose email already exists in HubSpot is rejected: the run stops with the details.

nodes.name: Wait For Contact Step
nodes.notes: Both paths meet here so the association step starts once, after every contact exists.

nodes.name: Build Associations
nodes.notes: Pairs every contact with its company, in batches of 100. Runs for new and existing contacts: association is idempotent.

nodes.name: Associate Contacts To Companies
nodes.notes: Default association (the company becomes the contact's primary company), up to 100 per call. Safe to repeat.

main.node: Build Company Map And Contact Batches
